system.description:
Cost: 1 Resolve

Range: 10 spaces

You have endured the suffering you endured to become a Stormcaller has made you incredibly resilient, and you have learned to extend that resilience to others.

When you or a creature within 10 spaces of you would gain the Dying condition, or be killed by a failed Death Check, or be instantly killed by another effect, you can spend 1 Resolve as a Free Action to prevent them from being killed or gaining the Dying condition.

Creatures affected by this ability can still have their Stamina reduced to 0, and their Wounds can still fill to their maximum value.

This cannot prevent the death of a creature that chooses to take a Last Stand.
